extension.summary: Browse your Immich photo and video library
extension.description: An unofficial plugin for Immich. Browse your library by month, album, person, place, tag or memory, search it by text or by description, and play it back on your TV. Requires an Immich server and an API key.
extension.news: v2.0.0 - Fixed menu entries showing a generic video icon; every entry now has its own artwork. - Timeline no longer makes one API request per photo. Opening a month is dramatically faster. - Added People, Places, Tags, Memories, Favourites, Search and Random. - Added slideshow support from any listing. - Detects the Immich server version and adapts, from 1.13x through 3.x. - Fixed a crash on a fresh install before settings were entered. - Albums keep working on Immich 3.x, which removed the embedded asset list. - Added a connection test, an SSL override for self-signed certificates and a network timeout.
